1953, August 13
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten orig- inal by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
ST. FELIX FRIARY HUNTINGTON, INDIANA
August 13th 1953
Blessed be God! In all His designs.
God bless you Dear Brother, Father Edward!
I want to reach you with this as soon as possible so that it be convenient for you to profit by a little proposition - up my sleeve since your interesting let- ter from White Plains, in reference to your betsg plans to be in the Green Bay Diocese during August. You probably remember me telling you about Mr. Philip Obrien of Chicago - just now on his summer-farm ?if- teen miles out of Bailey's Harbor, Wisconsin, I
called his amiable Wife Eleanor last nite - a little like Mrs. Tom Tobin of fifty years ago. ... They were expecting you to call on them earlier in the Summer before they left Chicago. Now they will be expecting you to get in touch with them and to stay with them at least a few days before the Month slips by. Their telephone - please don't disapoint us, then & - is : 15 R. 34. Waseda Farm Bailey's Harbor, Wisconsin. "Be sure and have him reverse charges. We will see to his coming."
P.M. Well, I did miss this a.m.'s pick-up, but I hope to reach you soon enough to make it conveni- ent for you/ see them in the near future. In a way I am confident that it will be close at least to as good as a "parish apointment,"
